title: Rav Huna bar Avya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Batra 143a, where Rav Ashi said to Rav Mordekhai: “This is why I saw Rav Huna bar Avya in a dream.” Hyman suggests that possibly he is the one mentioned in Chullin 47a, Rav Huna Mar bar Avya, who said to Rav Ashi, “All these wild animals have it this way”; and there at 49a, Huna Mar son of Rav Idi — Dikdukei Soferim reads bar Avya — who disagrees with Rav Ada bar Minyomi; they came and asked Ravina.

notes.text: חיוי ברייתא denotes wild animals in the lung-lobe discussion, not outside snakes. Saved Davidson Chullin 47a supports the term and full Rav Huna Mar bar Avya form. Hyman’s possible identification and the Idi/Avya manuscript variant remain qualified.
